title: 제13구역의 기록자: 2화
summary: 실험체 세타가 강서진의 잊고 싶었던 과거의 기억을 꺼내며 격리실을 공포로 물들인다.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: Close-up of kang, cold fluorescent flickering lights, sharp and analytical expression, looking through the metallic two-way mirror in the underground concrete interrogation room.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.shot: Medium shot of subject, pale translucent skin, long silver-white hair covering the face, wearing standard orange containment jumpsuit, leaning unnaturally close to the glass with a subtle smile.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: Extreme close-up of kang, widening dark eyes, dropping her pen in sudden shock, claustrophobic and tense atmosphere.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.line: 그날 밤 불에 타던 네 동생.
scenes.shot: Wide shot of the interrogation room, heavy steel security doors in the background, subject whispering towards the glass, eerie and cold blue lighting.

scenes.speaker: han
scenes.shot: Medium shot of han, dark tactical security uniform, rushing toward the glass with a stern and vigilant expression, hand on his weapon.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: Close-up of kang, trembling lips, staring directly at the subject with absolute terror and disbelief.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.line: 네 기억 속에 내가 살고 있거든.
scenes.shot: Close-up of subject, face pressed against the glass, eyes glowing faintly in the dark, unnatural and menacing movement.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: Wide dark shot of the underground facility, flickering lights going out one by one, leaving only an eerie silence.

cta: 과거를 아는 변칙 존재의 정체는? 다음 화에서 확인하세요. 구독!
description: 비밀 격리 시설 제13구역. 수석 연구원 강서진은 실험체 세타와의 인터뷰 중 자신의 지우고 싶은 과거를 마주한다.
